message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a men's waterproof pull-on boot with a rubber/plastic upper, textile gores, and an outer sole flocked with leather. The key classification issue is the outer sole material, which is rubber/plastics with a leather flocking. Under Chapter 64 Note 4(a), the outer sole material is the one that gives the greatest surface contact with the ground. Here the leather flocking completely obscures the rubber, so the outer sole is treated as leather. The upper is rubber/plastic, so heading 6401 to 6402 would normally apply, with the upper material determining the heading when the outer sole is rubber/plastic. With a leather outer sole, though, 6401 to 6405 depend on the sole too. Heading 6401 requires an outer sole and upper of rubber/plastics. Heading 6402 also requires both outer sole and upper of rubber or plastics. A leather outer sole therefore takes the boot to 6403 or 6405. Heading 6405 covers other footwear, and 6403 requires an outer sole of rubber, plastics, leather, or composition leather with an upper of leather. The upper here is rubber/plastic, so the boot falls under 6405.

Within 6405, subheading 6405.10 covers uppers of leather or composition leather, and 6405.20 covers uppers of textile materials. 6405.90 covers other. A rubber/plastic upper therefore goes to 6405.90. The statistical suffix is 6405.90.9060 for men's footwear. The 6405.90.90 line has suffixes 30 for... I'm not certain, but I believe 6405.90.9060 is the one for other footwear.
